evidence.note: The list headed בְּנֵי שֵׁם names Arpachshad between Asshur and Lud.
Arpachshad fathers Shelah, who in turn fathers Eber.

name: אַרְפַּכְשַׁד
summary: Genesis 10:22 names Arpachshad among the sons of Shem. Genesis 10:24 names him as the father of Shelah and grandfather of Eber. The name’s etymology is uncertain.
